notes.title: The last bugfix before full release! v0.5.1
notes.notes:
Preparing for the upcoming full release of Escape the Grid VR here's the latest minor bugfix update.



For any feedback/questions/... you can find us on discord at: https://discord.gg/v7CaZP8

notes.title: The third corridor is out now! - v0.5.0
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce that the third corridor of the game is out now! 
This means 10 new levels with brand new features, such as gravity change, bouncy pads, "Simon Says" and much more.

This is the second-last major update before the full release, here is a list of the various changes and additions:

[list]
[*] 10 new playable levels
[*] Rebalancing of the initial levels (*)
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

(*) The levels of the first corridor have been slightly reworked to improve the learning curve for new players;





For any feedback/questions/... you can find us on discord at: https://discord.gg/v7CaZP8

notes.title: Second corridor is here! - v0.4.0
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce that the second corridor is now available! Lots of new challenging gameplay mechanics to try!
This brand new update also comes with many minor and major bug fixes.

For the occasion, we decided to recreate the game trailer in order to showcase and better rappresent the current state of the game.
We are already working on the next corridor and since we are halfway to the end, we also started to design the very last level which we are sure you will enjoy.


Bug fixes highlights:

[list]
    [*]Corrected the respawning behaviour
    [*]Fixed major "Move to the next checkpoint" related bug
[/list]


For any feedback/questions/... you can find us on discord at: https://discord.gg/v7CaZP8

notes.title: New features, subtitles and various tweaks - v0.3.0
notes.notes:
This update has the goal to improve and simplify the game experience.


Here is a list of new features and game changes:

[*]In-game subtitles (1)
[*]Skippable checkpoints (2)
[*]Minor level design changes
[*]Insights of game ending added
[*]Level indicator label added
[*]Minor bug fixes


(1) Every dialog is now subtitled in english. This option can be toggled via the options menu.

(2) If you are struggling in a part of a level, you can now skip it by teleporting to the next checkpoint using the new button in the quick menu. Every level has a limited amount of time you can use this feature (some are even unskippable). By using this function, your level's highscore won't be submitted to the server. This option is still experimental and might be subjected to malfunctions.


For any feedback/questions/... you can find us on discord at: https://discord.gg/v7CaZP8

notes.title: Bug fixes and option menu changes - v0.2.3
notes.notes:
Other than some bug fixes in this version we reworked the experimental option menu based on the received feedback. 
We also added a climbing and landing sound.
You can now also reset your local highscores via the option menu.

For any feedback/questions/... you can find us on discord at: https://discord.gg/v7CaZP8

notes.title: Major climbing fixes and experimental options menu - v0.2.2
notes.notes:
Thanks to users feedback we managed to locate and fix multiple bugs related to the climbing mechanic (i.e. the view rotation stretching bug). 
You can now also access an experimental option menu available via the game menu.

For any feedback/questions/... you can find us on discord at: https://discord.gg/v7CaZP8

notes.title: v0.2.1 is out!
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce that the version 0.2.1 of Escape the Grid VR is out.


Here a list of new features and game changes:
[*]Scoreboard with personal highscores(*)
[*]Scoreboard with global highscores(*)
[*]Climbing throw major change (**)
[*]Level 1/2/3 rework (***)
[*]Tutorial minor changes
[*]Fixes and tunings of the movements(****)
[*]Added view rotation support via oculus joystick or vive touchpad swipe
[*]Fixed sondtrack shuffle issues
[*]Added oculus controllers images in the tutorial level
[*]Minor design changes



(*)You can check your personal and global score in the game hub, either via the level pillar (personal scores) or an interactable panel in the main hall (global scoreboard). Also, while playing any level, you can check your current run time by looking at the back of your controller;

(**)Based on the feedback we received, we changed the way you throw yourself while climbing: from the direction you were looking, to the direction of your actual controller movement;

(***)We simplified some tedious parts in the early levels to improve the game experience for new players;

(****)We tuned the timings and the actual forces of the hand thrusters, fixed the double hand thruster not being properly registered

notes.title: Bug fixes and movements rework
notes.notes:
As previously said, in the last 2 days we worked hard in recreating the tutorial to improve the user-experience and change the learning curve for new players.

We've decided to add some videos to show the movements that players needs to use in order to advance through the levels.
The character controller (the part of the code responsible for the in-game movements) has been reworked to have a better experience overall.

If you were disappointed in this game and didn't have a chance to try it at his full potential, we kindly suggest you to give it another try after this update.

Thanks again for the patience!

notes.title: Improving the tutorial
notes.notes:
Since we received multiple feedback regarding the effectiveness of the game tutorial, we started working immediatly on different improvements to let you fully understand the intended movements inside "Escape The Grid VR".

An update will be coming out in the next few days.
Thanks for your patience.

For any questions/feedback you can reach us on discord at: https://discord.gg/v7CaZP8

notes.title: Escape The Grid VR Early Access Release
notes.notes:
We are really proud to announce that Escape The Grid VR is finally out in Early Access on Steam.

You can also grab your copy at 10% off the first week.

It's been 3 months of hard work, now it will be even harder!

We already have a couple of updates for you, ready to be out in the upcoming weeks.
To follow the development and get in touch with us remember to join our Discord at: https://discord.gg/v7CaZP8
